_about: Annex E (decision 0162 item 3), the step-by-step change log from v4-s37 (v1.0) to the corrected release (v4-s39). One row per change, in build order, with its own measured effect on the headline (headline_2002_24_gbp_bn, £bn, 2024 prices, total 2002-24). Rows are added by each build card; the release card (t_a6fd25b7) filled every 'pending' row with its effect as measured on the release-candidate builds named in each row (work/t_a6fd25b7/fill_change_log.py). Figures here are measured on unreleased builds, each on the base its card names; none is a released figure. Read by tools/figures_keys/annex_v11.py into annex_e_change_log. v4-s40 (card t_18235261) appends the three step-3 items of decision 0175, each marked release v4-s40, so the log runs from v4-s37 to v4-s40. v4-s42 (card t_4c8d4798) appends the seven input-audit fixes of decision 0195, each measured alone against v4-s41 on the unsealed candidate (t_9d806708), and their measured interaction, each marked release v4-s42, so the log runs from v4-s37 to v4-s42 (v4-s41 moved no value). v4-s43 (card t_b7f775eb) appends decision 0197, each year's own NI station list for 2002-05, measured against v4-s42, marked release v4-s43, so the log runs from v4-s37 to v4-s43.
